_comment: The three standard gates (CONTRACTS §7.3) in the form apply_gates.py evaluates. A project's gates.json may ADD gates (objects with name + requires); it may not remove or change these. Predicates: CONTRACTS §7.1.

gates.name: release-candidate
gates.description: Builds, tests ran, no BLOCKER. A LOW FAIL on a non-critical check does not stop a candidate.

gates.name: production-ready
gates.description: Every applicable owner with complete coverage, no BLOCKER/CRITICAL, and the non-negotiable areas (security, release) 100% PASS.

gates.name: sellable
gates.description: Production-ready and fit to sell: activation, licence, support, error paths all verified.
